SELECT password_hash FROM teacher_accounts WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_users SET email=#{email}, email_verified_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, account_status='ENABLED' WHERE id=#{id} AND email IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT lock_id FROM identity_locks WHERE lock_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_users(id,login_name,email,display_name,password_hash,account_status,email_verified_at,terms_accepted_at) VALUES(#{id},CONCAT('email:',#{id}),#{email},#{name},#{hash},#{status}, CASE WHEN #{verified} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{terms} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE app_users SET email=#{email},password_hash=#{hash},account_status='ENABLED', email_verified_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,auth_version=auth_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND account_status='PENDING_ACTIVATION'
UPDATE app_users SET display_name=#{name} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE app_users SET auth_version=auth_version+1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM admin_bootstrap WHERE slot=1
SELECT CASE WHEN completed_at IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END FROM admin_bootstrap WHERE slot=1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_bootstrap SET user_id=#{id} WHERE slot=1 AND user_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS "id",u.email AS "email",u.display_name AS "displayName",u.account_status AS "status", i.delivery_status AS "deliveryStatus", CASE WHEN u.email_verified_at IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS "verified" FROM app_users u LEFT JOIN account_invitations i ON i.user_id=u.id WHERE (#{email}='' OR INSTR(u.email,#{email}) > 0) AND (#{role}='' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=u.id AND r.role_code=#{role})) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.id AS "id",u.login_name AS "legacyLogin",t.login_name AS "teacherLogin", u.display_name AS "displayName", i.email AS "email", i.delivery_status AS "deliveryStatus", u.account_status AS "status" FROM app_users u LEFT JOIN teacher_accounts t ON t.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN account_invitations i ON i.user_id=u.id WHERE u.email IS NULL ORDER BY u.id
SELECT role_code AS "code",role_name AS "name" FROM sys_roles ORDER BY role_code
SELECT permission_code AS "code",permission_name AS "name" FROM sys_permissions ORDER BY permission_code
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_roles SET role_name=#{name} WHERE role_code=#{role}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_users u JOIN sys_user_roles r ON r.user_id=u.id AND r.role_code='ADMIN' WHERE u.account_status='ENABLED' AND u.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_permissions p WHERE p.role_code='ADMIN' AND p.permission_code IN ('role:assign','permission:assign','user:enable'))=3
mapper.sql: user_id AS "userId",email AS "email",purpose AS "purpose", token_digest AS "digest",expires_at AS "expiresAt",delivery_status AS "status"

mapper.update: UPDATE managed_settings SET setting_value=#{value} WHERE setting_key=#{key}
